title: Mom Goes Berserk Fights & Kicks Officer & Steals Police Cruiser Key!
description:
On January 9th, 2024, a deputy in Florida out on patrol spots a silver Nissan traveling eastbound.

After leaving the scene to transport the suspect to jail, officers discovered the suspect had stolen the key to another officer's police cruiser. Upon searching for the suspect at the jail, the officer found the suspect concealing the key in her hand in the back seat of the cruiser. Due to her actions, she was additionally charged with Theft.

At the time of her arrest, the suspect was serving three years of probation for a previous incident involving leaving the scene of a crash involving injury. The court set the suspect's bond at $35,000. In court the suspect pleaded not guilty to all charges. The court later dismissed all charges except for driving on a revoked license. The court sentenced the suspect to 120 days in jail with 46 days served, alongside a $500 fine on court costs.
